mods.name: Umbrellas
mods.description: Adds Umbrellas that can shelter you from the elements (and look incredibly stylish!)

releases.notes:
- Regular fire can now boost umbrellas along with campfires
  - The blocks that boost Umbrellas are now determined via the tag `umbrellas:boosts_umbrellas`, meaning datapacks can add or remove blocks
- Added Umbrella Durability (can be disabled in configs)
  - An Umbrella can last a total of 10 minutes straight in the rain before breaking
- Umbrellas can now be enchanted with Unbreaking and Mending
- The function of the Gliding enchantment has been split into two enchantments
  - Wind Catching (for boosting upwards in smoke)
    - There is now an achievement for getting a Wind Catching Umbrella, like the one for Gliding Umbrellas
  - Gliding (for slow falling)
- When falling with an Umbrella, the player now moves their arm up (basically lets you more accurately roleplay as Mary Poppins)
  - This is purely visual and has no effect on gameplay
- Added 5 new additional Umbrella designs
  - These designs are crafted with new recipes.
  - They're meant to have a specific look not obtainable with Umbrella Patterns, so they cannot be dyed/patterned
  - Most of them come from back when this was a private mod for a specific server, and some people got themselves personal Umbrella designs. I decided that, rather than let them go to waste, they should be added to the public version of the mod
- These designs include:
  - Animals Umbrella
    - An Umbrella with an Axolotl and a Calico Cat sitting on it
  - Azalea Umbrella
    - A giant Flowering Azalea, large enough to function as an Umbrella
  - Galactic Umbrella
    - An Umbrella with Planets dangling down from strings
  - Gothic Umbrella
    - A gothic-inspired, fancy-looking Umbrella
  - Jellyfish Umbrella
    - A poor jellyfish that's been impaled on a spike, and now functions as an Umbrella

mods.name: Umbrellas
mods.description: Adds Umbrellas that can shelter you from the elements (and look incredibly stylish!)

releases.notes:
- Added Umbrella Stands, which basically allow for placeable umbrellas in builds
  - They of course also shelter entities from light
- Reworked the entire system for umbrella customization:
  - Standard dyeable umbrellas can be combined with any banner to create a "patternable" umbrella
    - Regular dyeable umbrellas remain the same and can still be dyed any RGB color
    - Patternable umbrellas are just named after the banner you used, e.g. Umbrella + Blue Banner -> Blue Umbrella
  - Looms can be used to apply Umbrella Patterns to patternable umbrellas
    - There are equivalents to all vanilla banner patterns, as well as some special new ones
  - There are some umbrella patterns that require items to access (similarly to vanilla banner patterns)
    - Almost all umbrella pattern items can simply be crafted from their banner pattern counterparts, e.g. Globe Banner Pattern -> Globe Umbrella Pattern
    - The only exception is the pride umbrella pattern item, which is crafted with Paper + Glow Ink Sac
      - This pattern allows access to all pride flag patterns, rather than just one
  - Pride umbrellas have been removed, due to having been replaced by pride flag umbrella patterns
    - The mod will attempt to migrate pride umbrella item IDs to regular umbrellas
